2.0.0: Make previously private components public: ListBoards, ListBoardsCards, ListBoardMembers, ListBoardsList, ListBoardCardLabels, ListBoardLabels.
Make Board ID and other input properties variable by moving them to inPorts.
Fix component FindBoard not returning any value when no result is found.
2.0.1: Fix 'invalid id' error when using AddLabelToCard component.
2.0.3: Update component description for: ListBoardsCards, ListBoardsList, ListBoardLabels, ListBoardMembers, ListBoards and ListCardLabels.
2.0.4: Fix 'Bad Request' error when sending data in body in GET requests.
2.1.1: Update component CreateCard to include checklist.
Fix an issue when it was possible to create a card without a name.
Add component DeleteCard, ListCardChecklists, ListChecklistItems, AddChecklistToCard, AddItemToChecklist, UpdateChecklist, UpdateChecklistItem, DeleteChecklist, DeleteChecklistItem.
2.1.3: Updated the list of colors in color-palette of AddLabelToCard component and updated the tooltip texts and description
In AddLabelToCard component, implemented the codition to select anyOf the two options instead of oneOf.
2.1.4: Fixed the issue with the CreateCard component where `idChecklists` was not being sent to the output port.
2.1.5: Fixed an issue with AddChecklistToCard where whitespace in the checklist items was not being trimmed.
2.1.6: Added output examples to component schemas.
2.2.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewCard, NewActivity, NewNotification — each reuses the shared trello-commons.fetchAll request path with tick() and emits the newest matching item (picked via the Trello id timestamp).
2.3.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Trello API.
2.3.1: Added output schemas with examples to the NewNotification trigger.
2.3.2: AddLabelToCard, CreateCard, NewActivity and NewCard: the board, list, card and label pickers are now typeahead text fields, so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load; added output schemas with examples.
2.3.3: CreateBoard now stops with a clear error when the board name is missing instead of calling the API; added output schemas with examples.
2.3.4: AddItemToChecklist and UpdateChecklistItem no longer declare idBoard, which a checklist item does not have; AddItemToChecklist now declares the boardListCardId it emits and pos as the number Trello returns. Required-input checks and typeahead board / card / list / member pickers for the card, board and checklist-item actions; output schemas with examples.
2.3.5: Output examples for FindBoard, FindCard and FindMember. FindMember's board and organization limit options read the nested limits.boards / limits.orgs objects (they pointed at dotted keys and resolved to nothing).
2.3.6: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
2.3.7: Await context.sendJson in FindCard and FindMember so outputs are sent before receive() resolves.
